natural: Heart lifted up and courage hanging in the air

meaning.en: On tenterhooks; constantly afraid that something bad will happen.
meaning.zh: 形容十分担心或害怕，心神不安。

equivalents: have one's heart in one's mouth

examples.zh: 他第一次一个人开车上高速，一路上提心吊胆。
examples.en: It was his first time driving alone on the motorway, and he was on edge the whole way.

examples.zh: 公司天天传裁员的消息，大家都过得提心吊胆。
examples.en: With rumours of lay-offs every day, everyone at the company is living on tenterhooks.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (提心吊胆地过日子). Describes ongoing fear rather than a sudden fright. 胆 (gallbladder) stands for courage.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，如"提心吊胆地过日子"。指持续的担心害怕，而非一时受惊。

literal: bend to · private · play with · fraud
natural: Bend the rules for private gain and commit fraud

meaning.en: To abuse one's position for personal favours and commit fraud; malpractice.
meaning.zh: 为了私情而用欺骗的方法做违法乱纪的事。

examples.zh: 这名官员因徇私舞弊被撤职查办。
examples.en: The official was dismissed and investigated for abusing his office.

examples.zh: 考试中如发现徇私舞弊，成绩一律作废。
examples.en: Any results obtained through malpractice in the exam will be cancelled.

usage.en: Formal; common in news, law and official notices. Usually describes officials or people in charge, not ordinary cheating.
usage.zh: 书面语，多用于新闻、法律和公文，多指有职权的人。

natural: Not knowing a single thing

meaning.en: To know nothing at all about something.
meaning.zh: 什么也不知道。

examples.zh: 我对股票一无所知，不敢随便投资。
examples.en: I know nothing about stocks, so I don't dare invest on a whim.

examples.zh: 出了这么大的事，他居然一无所知。
examples.en: Something this big happened and he was completely in the dark.

usage.en: Predicate, often with 对……一无所知. Neutral; can describe honest ignorance, not only foolishness. 一 is read yì here in speech (before 2nd tone wú).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"对……一无所知"。"一"在口语中变调读 yì。

natural: Keep carving and never stop

meaning.en: To persevere without giving up; to keep at something with determination.
meaning.zh: 不断地镂刻。比喻有恒心，有毅力，坚持不懈。

equivalents: dripping water wears away the stone

examples.zh: 经过十年锲而不舍的研究，他终于找到了答案。
examples.en: After ten years of dogged research, he finally found the answer.

examples.zh: 学语言需要锲而不舍的精神。
examples.en: Learning a language takes a spirit of perseverance.

story.en: Xunzi's "Encouraging Learning": "Carve and then stop, and even rotten wood won't break; carve without stopping, and even metal and stone can be engraved" (锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂).
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》："锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂。"

usage.en: Attributive (锲而不舍的精神) or adverbial. Slightly literary; 锲 is qiè. Common in essays about study and work.
usage.zh: 多作定语、状语，如"锲而不舍的精神"。"锲"读 qiè。常见于作文。

natural: Having some other purpose in mind

meaning.en: To have ulterior motives; to harbour a hidden, usually bad, intention.
meaning.zh: 心中另有打算，指另有不可告人的企图。

examples.zh: 他突然对我这么热情，我怀疑他别有用心。
examples.en: He's suddenly so friendly to me — I suspect he has an ulterior motive.

examples.zh: 有些别有用心的人在网上散布谣言。
examples.en: Some people with hidden agendas are spreading rumours online.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (别有用心的人). Derogatory; common in news commentary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"别有用心的人"。贬义，新闻评论中常见。

natural: Careful and diligent

meaning.en: Conscientious and hard-working; doing one's job carefully and diligently.
meaning.zh: 形容做事谨慎、勤恳、认真负责。

examples.zh: 王老师在学校兢兢业业工作了三十年。
examples.en: Ms Wang worked conscientiously at the school for thirty years.

examples.zh: 他平时兢兢业业，从来没出过差错。
examples.en: He's always diligent and has never made a mistake.

story.en: In the Book of Documents, the minister Gao Yao advises the ruler to be "cautious and diligent, for each day brings ten thousand matters" (兢兢业业，一日二日万几).
story.zh: 《尚书·皋陶谟》："兢兢业业，一日二日万几。"劝君主谨慎勤勉。

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate (兢兢业业地工作). Praises long-term diligence at work; common in tributes and reports.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。称赞长期勤恳工作，常用于表彰和报道。

natural: Plain and easy to understand

meaning.en: Written or said in plain language that is easy to understand.
meaning.zh: 浅显易懂，适合一般人的水平。

examples.zh: 这本科普书写得通俗易懂，孩子也能看。
examples.en: This popular-science book is written so plainly that even children can read it.

examples.zh: 请用通俗易懂的话向客户解释合同条款。
examples.en: Please explain the contract terms to the client in plain language.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Describes explanations, books and language. A set phrase rather than a classical idiom.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多形容文章、讲解、语言。

natural: Nothing can be done about it

meaning.en: Helpless; having no way out; to have to accept something one cannot change.
meaning.zh: 没有办法，只能如此。

examples.zh: 雨一直下，比赛只好取消，大家都无可奈何。
examples.en: It kept raining and the match had to be cancelled — there was nothing anyone could do.

examples.zh: 他无可奈何地叹了口气。
examples.en: He sighed helplessly.

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial (无可奈何地) or attributive. Famous line: 晏殊's "无可奈何花落去" (helplessly the flowers fall).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语、定语。晏殊名句"无可奈何花落去"。

natural: Excellent in both character and studies

meaning.en: Of good character and excellent at one's studies.
meaning.zh: 品德和学业都很优秀。

examples.zh: 她品学兼优，连续三年获得奖学金。
examples.en: A model student in conduct and grades, she won a scholarship three years in a row.

examples.zh: 学校每年评选品学兼优的学生。
examples.en: Every year the school selects students who excel in both character and studies.

usage.en: Used almost only about students; common in school reports and awards.
usage.zh: 几乎只用于学生，常见于评语和表彰。

natural: Push the waves and help the billows along

meaning.en: To add fuel to the fire; to make a bad situation or trend worse.
meaning.zh: 比喻从旁鼓动、助长事物（多指坏的事物）的声势和发展。

examples.zh: 一些媒体推波助澜，让谣言越传越广。
examples.en: Some media outlets fanned the flames, and the rumour spread further and further.

examples.zh: 投机资金推波助澜，房价进一步上涨。
examples.en: Speculative money added fuel to the fire, pushing house prices even higher.

story.en: The Sui scholar Wang Tong wrote that certain historical events "only served to push the waves and help the billows" (适足推波助澜), making a trend worse.
story.zh: 隋代王通《中说·问易》："真君、建德之事，适足推波助澜。"

usage.en: Predicate. Usually negative, about rumours, trends and conflicts; occasionally neutral (helping a positive trend).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。多用于贬义，指助长谣言、风气、冲突等。

natural: Tiny, very tiny

meaning.en: Extremely small; negligible.
meaning.zh: 形容非常少或非常小。

examples.zh: 比分落后这么多，赢的希望微乎其微。
examples.en: So far behind on the scoreboard, their chances of winning are slim to none.

examples.zh: 这点改动对整体效果的影响微乎其微。
examples.en: This small change has a negligible effect on the overall result.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 可能性、希望、影响 (chance, hope, effect).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"可能性、希望、影响"等搭配。

natural: Mention them together and discuss them as equals

meaning.en: To put two things on a par; to mention in the same breath. Usually negated.
meaning.zh: 把不同的人或事放在一起谈论或看待（多用于否定）。

examples.zh: 业余爱好和专业水平不能相提并论。
examples.en: Amateur interest and professional skill can't be mentioned in the same breath.

examples.zh: 这两部电影风格完全不同，很难相提并论。
examples.en: The two films are completely different in style — it's hard to compare them.

usage.en: Predicate, usually after 不能、无法、难以. Often with 把……与……相提并论.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于否定"不能/无法/难以相提并论"。

natural: Dead ashes flare up again

meaning.en: Something thought to be finished (usually bad) revives.
meaning.zh: 冷灰重新烧了起来。比喻已经停止活动的事物又重新活动起来（多指坏事）。

examples.zh: 严查之后，赌博活动又有死灰复燃的迹象。
examples.en: After the crackdown, there are signs that gambling is rearing its head again.

examples.zh: 要防止这种不良风气死灰复燃。
examples.en: We must stop this bad practice from coming back.

story.en: When Han Anguo was in prison, a jailer humiliated him. Han asked, "Can't dead ashes burn again?" The jailer replied, "If they do, I'll piss on them." Han later regained high office.
story.zh: 韩安国坐牢时受狱吏田甲侮辱，说："死灰独不复然乎？"田甲说："然即溺之。"后来韩安国果然复官。

usage.en: Predicate. Mostly about bad things returning (crime, bad habits, epidemics); originally neutral.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指坏事、坏风气重新出现。

natural: Fighting for every minute and second

meaning.en: To race against time; to make use of every moment.
meaning.zh: 一分一秒也不放过，形容充分利用时间。

examples.zh: 救援人员争分夺秒，搜寻被困群众。
examples.en: Rescuers raced against the clock to find people trapped in the rubble.

examples.zh: 考试前一周，大家都在争分夺秒地复习。
examples.en: In the week before the exam, everyone was revising against the clock.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (争分夺秒地). Common in news about rescues, construction and exams.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。新闻中常用于救援、施工、备考等。

natural: Gather everyone's ideas to widen the benefit

meaning.en: To pool ideas from many people to get the best result.
meaning.zh: 集中群众的智慧，广泛吸收有益的意见。

equivalents: two heads are better than one

examples.zh: 这个方案还不成熟，我们开个会集思广益吧。
examples.en: The plan isn't fully formed yet — let's hold a meeting and pool our ideas.

examples.zh: 政府通过网络征求意见，集思广益。
examples.en: The government gathered suggestions online to draw on public wisdom.

origin.source: 三国·诸葛亮《教与军师长史参军掾属》

story.en: Zhuge Liang told his officials that the purpose of council was "to gather many minds and widen loyal benefit" (集众思，广忠益), urging them to speak frankly.
story.zh: 诸葛亮说："夫参署者，集众思，广忠益也。"鼓励属下直言献策。

usage.en: Predicate. Common in meetings, management and government contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于会议、管理和政务。

natural: Remake one's life by one's own strength

meaning.en: Self-reliance; to rely on one's own efforts to improve one's situation.
meaning.zh: 依靠自己的力量把事情办好，改变面貌。

equivalents: stand on one's own two feet
pull oneself up by one's bootstraps

examples.zh: 村民们自力更生，修好了通往镇上的路。
examples.en: Relying on themselves, the villagers built a road to the town.

examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他决心自力更生，不再向家里要钱。
examples.en: After graduating, he resolved to stand on his own two feet and stop asking his family for money.

usage.en: Predicate. A 20th-century political slogan (often paired with 艰苦奋斗), now also used about individuals.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。二十世纪常见政治口号（常与"艰苦奋斗"连用），现也用于个人。

natural: Shoot the arrow at a target

meaning.en: To act or speak with a clear aim; targeted and to the point.
meaning.zh: 对准靶子射箭。比喻说话做事有明确目的，有针对性。

examples.zh: 了解学生的弱点后，老师的辅导就能有的放矢。
examples.en: Once the teacher knows the students' weak points, the tutoring can be targeted.

examples.zh: 做市场调查是为了有的放矢地制定营销策略。
examples.en: We do market research so that our marketing strategy can be targeted.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (有的放矢地). 的 is read dì (target), not de. Popularised in 20th-century political writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。"的"读 dì，指箭靶。

natural: Win distinction and build a great career

meaning.en: To make great achievements and contributions.
meaning.zh: 建立功勋，成就事业。

examples.zh: 他年轻时就立志要建功立业。
examples.en: He was determined from a young age to achieve great things.

examples.zh: 新时代为青年建功立业提供了广阔舞台。
examples.en: The new era offers young people a broad stage on which to make their mark.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal and aspirational; common in speeches and official writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。书面语，常见于讲话和公文。

natural: A mountain of people, a sea of people

meaning.en: Huge crowds of people.
meaning.zh: 人群像山像海一样，形容聚集的人非常多。

examples.zh: 国庆节的景区人山人海。
examples.en: Tourist spots are packed with people during the National Day holiday.

examples.zh: 演唱会门口人山人海，根本挤不进去。
examples.en: There was a sea of people outside the concert — no way to squeeze in.

usage.en: Predicate. Everyday and vivid; very common in speech.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。口语常用，形象生动。

natural: Routed so badly it is no longer an army

meaning.en: Utterly routed; defeated so badly that one falls apart.
meaning.zh: 被打得七零八落，不成队伍。形容惨败。

examples.zh: 敌军遭到突袭，溃不成军。
examples.en: Taken by surprise, the enemy army was routed.

examples.zh: 下半场主队连丢四球，溃不成军。
examples.en: The home team conceded four goals in the second half and fell apart completely.

usage.en: Predicate. Originally military; now common in sports reporting and business.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。原指军队，现常用于体育、商业报道。

natural: Clear waters and green mountains

meaning.en: Beautiful natural scenery; an unspoilt environment.
meaning.zh: 泛指美好的山水风光、良好的生态环境。

examples.zh: 这里绿水青山，空气清新，是度假的好地方。
examples.en: With its clear rivers and green hills and fresh air, it's a great place for a holiday.

examples.zh: "绿水青山就是金山银山"已成为环保的口号。
examples.en: "Clear waters and green mountains are mountains of gold and silver" has become an environmental slogan.

usage.en: Also 青山绿水. Today strongly associated with the slogan 绿水青山就是金山银山 (a healthy environment is wealth), common in news.
usage.zh: 也作"青山绿水"。现常见于"绿水青山就是金山银山"的说法。

natural: Seek common ground and set differences aside

meaning.en: To seek common ground while reserving differences.
meaning.zh: 找出共同点，保留不同意见。

examples.zh: 双方本着求同存异的原则达成了协议。
examples.en: The two sides reached agreement on the principle of seeking common ground while setting aside differences.

examples.zh: 朋友之间看法不同很正常，求同存异就好。
examples.en: It's normal for friends to disagree — just agree to disagree.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Famous from Zhou Enlai's speech at the 1955 Bandung Conference; common in diplomacy and negotiation.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。因1955年周恩来在万隆会议上的发言而广为人知，常用于外交和谈判。

natural: Hard to tell one from the other

meaning.en: Confusing and complicated; hard to make sense of.
meaning.zh: 形容事物错综复杂，难以辨别清楚。

examples.zh: 这起案件扑朔迷离，警方至今没有找到线索。
examples.en: The case is shrouded in mystery; police still have no leads.

examples.zh: 小说情节扑朔迷离，读到最后才知道凶手是谁。
examples.en: The novel's plot is so tangled that you only find out who the killer is at the very end.

story.en: The Ballad of Mulan ends: "The male hare's feet kick about, the female hare's eyes are blurry; when two hares run side by side, who can tell male from female?" (雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离…)
story.zh: 《木兰诗》："雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌？"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Used about cases, plots, situations and markets.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常形容案情、情节、局势。

natural: Can be counted on your fingers

meaning.en: Very few; so few you could count them on your fingers.
meaning.zh: 弯着手指就可以数清楚，形容数量很少。

examples.zh: 能用中文写小说的外国作家屈指可数。
examples.en: Foreign writers who can write novels in Chinese can be counted on one hand.

examples.zh: 这家店开业以来，顾客屈指可数。
examples.en: Customers have been few and far between since the shop opened.

usage.en: Predicate. Can praise rarity (top experts are 屈指可数) or point to scarcity.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。既可指稀少可贵，也可指数量少。

natural: Not careless by even a thread

meaning.en: Meticulous; scrupulously careful about every detail.
meaning.zh: 一点儿也不马虎，形容办事认真细致。

equivalents: dot every i and cross every t

examples.zh: 他做实验一丝不苟，每个数据都要核对三遍。
examples.en: He's meticulous in the lab and checks every figure three times.

examples.zh: 老师批改作文一丝不苟，连标点都不放过。
examples.en: The teacher marks essays with painstaking care, not even letting punctuation slip.

story.en: In The Scholars (ch. 4), a magistrate is praised because his superiors learn he is "not careless by even a thread" in his duties.
story.zh: 《儒林外史》第四回："上司访知，见世叔一丝不苟，升迁就在指日。"

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial or attributive. Praises carefulness at work or study. In speech 一 is read yì (before 1st-tone sī).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语、定语。"一"在口语中读 yì。
